div.div:
Cost controls
Each stack carries a cost-profile tag (idle or demo). No NAT gateway. Aurora pauses at 0 ACU. Kinesis, state machines, and Fargate exist only in the demo stack. Log groups keep 7 days. Measured model cost: $0.00206 per incident on average (gate-5.json). Idle cost: not measured yet.
